hints.title: Disjoint Component Aggregation Obstacle
hints.text: Every vertex starts as an isolated cluster. Merging endpoints of given edges joins distinct clusters together. How can monitoring cluster merges determine the total number of connected groups remaining?

hints.title: Component Count Decrement Invariant
hints.text: Each successful union operation between two previously disconnected components decrements the total component count by exactly one.

hints.title: Disjoint Set Component Tally Procedure
hints.text: Initialize a counter to n and assign each vertex its own canonical parent. For each edge, find the canonical parent of both endpoints. If the parents differ, link one parent to the other and decrement the component counter by one. Return the final count after considering all edges.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Path compression ensures almost instantaneous find and union steps for all edges.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: DFS/BFS traversals on sparse graphs require extra visited sets and recursion call stacks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Array of parents requires O(N) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Tracking the number of components dynamically during edge processing with DSU.
